_comment: Verbatim output of scripts/build-mirror.sh, captured 2026-08-11 against the
real repository. The other producer of this file -- the publishing job on
diluvium.aloecraft.org -- is captured in releases-mirror.json, and the Lab
This exists because the script decided the tag set itself, twice, and was
wrong both times: first a hardcoded list that went stale, then discovery
plus a name-based prerelease guess that mirrored v5.5.1_build3 -- which
upstream's own notes exclude. The set now comes from `mirror_tags` in the
Diluvium repository's changelog.json, and this pins the shape that reads.
Note this carries the *pinned* build (build2), which is what lets the
not-offered-twice test exercise the filter at all.
